source_record.title: AI Strategy Intern (m/w/d)
source_record.description:
YOUR TASKS

  • You support the analysis of business processes and the identification of optimization potential through the use of AI
  • You assist in advising business units and in developing tailored AI strategies
  • You contribute to the development of concepts, feasibility studies, and prototypes
  • You support the implementation and continuous optimization of AI solutions
  • You assist in conducting workshops and training sessions to foster AI literacy
  • You support our clients throughout their AI transformation initiatives


YOUR PROFIL

  • You are currently enrolled in a degree program in Business Administration, (Business) Informatics, Engineering, Natural Sciences, Mathematics, or a related discipline and have a solid foundational understanding of Artificial Intelligence
  • You have practical experience in Python
  • You have initial experience with common AI and ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain) as well as database systems (vector and graph databases) and possess a good understanding of technical implementation
  • You are confident in the technical design of solution approaches
  • You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • You are passionate about Artificial Intelligence and have a visionary perspective on how AI can transform the business world
  • You are a team player, highly motivated, adaptable, communicative, and proactive
  • You have strong presentation and facilitation skills
  • You are willing to travel
  • You possess excellent German and English language skills (minimum C1 level in both languages)


YOUR BENEFITS

  • Supportive Team Culture: Team cohesion is important to us - we support one another and foster a healthy office culture. Our event team organizes regular after-work events to encourage exchange and connection beyond the workplace.
  • Early Ownership & Responsibility: From day one, you will take on exciting tasks with real responsibility – whether on your project or by contributing to internal initiatives. You help shape the way we work.
  • Clear Career Development Paths: You will find an environment that supports, challenges, and advances your professional growth. We offer clearly defined career paths and a transparent competency framework for every level.
  • Creative Work Environment: We give you the freedom and time to develop creative solutions and provide the best, most modern hardware to support you (Apple or Windows).
  • Employee Benefits: Flexible working models, a BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit card, Wellpass, and a company pension scheme contribute to your well-being. In addition, you’ll enjoy the best coffee from our new espresso machine and a fully stocked soft drinks fridge in the office.
  • Attractive Vacation Policy: You benefit from 30 days of paid vacation per year and the flexibility to work from home.
